---
name: design-test
description: Use when writing test suite document, designing test cases for a feature.
---

Follow these steps when load this skill:

1. Read `docs/documentation-structure.md` to know how to find documentation
2. Locate and read the feature specification document of the requested feature.
3. Read https://c.lamhq.com/se/documentation/test-suite.html for the guidelines of writing test suite documentation.
4. Write test suite documentation for the requested feature, following the guidelines.

Note: all file locations are relative to the project root.
